A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

```python
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Choose candidate with fingers across the short axis (perpendicular to long axis)
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - (pen["long_axis_yaw"] + 0.5 * 3.1416)) < 0.1)

grasp(candidate)

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
# Choose spot where object's long axis matches case's long axis
spot = next(s for s in spots["spots"] if abs(s["object_long_axis_yaw"] - case["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)

# Carry with yaw set so that pen's long axis aligns with case's long axis
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=case["long_axis_yaw"])

lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
wait(20)

check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
```
